note: Spoken words from NASA's Apollo 11 air-to-ground and onboard voice transcripts (public domain), as reproduced with GET in the Apollo Flight Journal and the Apollo Lunar Surface Journal. Editors' bracketed and parenthetical notes are left out. 'onboard' lines were recorded inside the spacecraft and not heard on the ground at the time.
lines: Roger. We got a roll program.
Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go for TLI. Over.
We confirm ignition, and the thrust is Go.
11, this is Houston. You are Go for LOI. Over.
Eagle, Houston. We read you now. You're Go for PDI. Over.
Give us a reading on the 1202 Program Alarm.
Roger. We got you... We're Go on that alarm.
Eagle, you've got 30 seconds to P64.
Roger. Copy. Eagle, Houston. You're Go for landing. Over.
Roger. 1201 alarm. We're Go. Same type. We're Go.
60 feet, down 2 1/2. 2 forward. 2 forward. That's good.
40 feet, down 2 1/2. Picking up some dust.
Houston, Tranquility Base here. The Eagle has landed.
Roger, Twan... Tranquility. We copy you on the ground. You got a bunch of guys about to turn blue. We're breathing again. Thanks a lot.
Okay. I'm going to step off the LM now.
That's one small step for (a) man; one giant leap for mankind.
9, 8, 7, 6, 5, Abort Stage, Engine Arm, Ascent, Proceed.
We're off. Look at that stuff go all over the place. Look at that shadow. Beautiful.
Apollo 11, Houston. You are Go for TEI. Over.
Beautiful burn. SPS, I love you! You are a jewel!
Hey, Charlie boy, looking good here. That was a beautiful burn. They don't come any finer.
Hello, Hornet. This is Apollo 11 reading you loud and clear.
